name: handle_root_files_listed_in_project_conf_d84431e7
subject: Handle root files listed in project config from referenced project to be same as if they were included through import (#58560)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Root files listed in a project config from a referenced project were treated differently from files reached via import; the change records resolved roots in tsbuildinfo and uses them in tsbuild so the behaviour matches, fixing incorrect build/watch results.
